pages.text: Open your tamed hamster’s cheek inventory and retrieve one item.

pages.title: Safe in Your Cheeks
pages.text: A wheel immediately improves the hamster’s home and seeds supply care after the first real unloading.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Harvest Sunflower Seeds; they regrow after morning. Let the tame collect a harmless item, open its owner inventory and retrieve it. Avoid extreme heat or cold.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Offer Sunflower Seeds to a hamster and access its owner inventory. The tame collects items into cheek pouches; extreme temperatures are hazardous.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Harvest Sunflower Seeds and return after morning regrowth. The flower follows the sun and renews seeds for Hamster taming.
